primary_official_source.name: EUR-Lex -- Official Journal of the European Union

upcoming: Harmonised standard on conformity assessment for AI systems -- being developed by CEN and CENELEC under Commission Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871, Annex I, point 10; no date announced

obligations.source_quote: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider shall opt for one of the following conformity assessment procedures based on: (a) the internal control referred to in Annex VI; or (b) the assessment of the quality management system and the assessment of the technical documentation, with the involvement of a notified body, referred to in Annex VII.
obligations.scope_limitation: Applies to Annex III point 1 (biometrics) high-risk AI systems that are not covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I (those follow the procedure of that legislation, Art. 43(3), fourth subparagraph)

decomposed_atoms.description: Provider must perform conformity assessment (Annex VI internal control or Annex VII with notified body)
decomposed_atoms.requirement: SHALL opt for Annex VI or Annex VII conformity assessment procedure

cross_references.context: Art. 43(3), fourth subparagraph: "Where a high-risk AI system is both covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I and it falls within one of the categories listed in Annex III, the provider of that system shall follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required pursuant to the relevant Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I."

obligations.source_quote: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 2 to 8 of Annex III, providers shall follow the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control as referred to in Annex VI, which does not provide for the involvement of a notified body.

decomposed_atoms.description: Annex III points 2-8 systems use internal control (Annex VI)
decomposed_atoms.requirement: SHALL follow Annex VI internal control conformity assessment

obligations.scope_limitation: Applies to Annex III points 2-8 high-risk AI systems that are not covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I (those follow the procedure of that legislation, Art. 43(3), fourth subparagraph)

cross_references.context: Art. 43(3), fourth subparagraph: "Where a high-risk AI system is both covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I and it falls within one of the categories listed in Annex III, the provider of that system shall follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required pursuant to the relevant Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I."

obligations.source_quote: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the provider of the system shall follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required in accordance with the relevant Union harmonisation legislation. The requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter shall apply to those high-risk AI systems and shall be part of that assessment. Assessment of the quality management system set out in Article 17 shall also be undertaken, and points 3, 4.3, 4.4. and 4.5, the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 and point 5 of Annex VII shall apply.
obligations.scope_limitation: Only applies to Annex I product systems

decomposed_atoms.description: High-risk AI systems covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I follow the relevant sectoral conformity assessment
decomposed_atoms.requirement: The provider SHALL follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure required by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I

_history.requirement: SHALL follow relevant sectoral conformity assessment procedure
_history.description: Annex I product systems follow sectoral conformity assessment

decomposed_atoms.description: The Section 2 requirements are part of that assessment
decomposed_atoms.requirement: The requirements of Chapter III Section 2 SHALL apply to the system and SHALL be part of that conformity assessment

decomposed_atoms.description: The assessment also covers the Art. 17 quality management system
decomposed_atoms.requirement: Assessment of the quality management system set out in Article 17 SHALL also be undertaken as part of that conformity assessment

decomposed_atoms.description: Listed points of Annex VII apply to the assessment
decomposed_atoms.requirement: Points 3, 4.3, 4.4 and 4.5, the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 and point 5 of Annex VII SHALL apply

_source_quote_history.source_quote: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the provider shall follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required under those legal acts.

obligations.source_quote: High-risk AI systems that have already been subject to a conformity assessment procedure shall undergo a new conformity assessment procedure in the event of a substantial modification, regardless of whether the modified system is intended to be further distributed or continues to be used by the current deployer.

decomposed_atoms.description: New assessment required on substantial modification
decomposed_atoms.requirement: SHALL undergo new conformity assessment on substantial modification
